en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a historic European town with dense old buildings, a prominent round defensive tower by a river, a church with a tall spire, and several other towers rising above the rooftops. A bridge crosses the river in the foreground, and the overall style is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Red printed text at the top names the place and main landmarks.
